text:
chris: heads-up — during last night's scheduled firmware batch in aps1a, 4 GPU nodes failed to boot after the flash. nodes dropping into kernel oops / silent OOM. suspect BIOS image corruption on PCI devices. need immediate drain + replacement coordination.

infra-bot: detected offline nodes: aps1a-rack7-node12, aps1a-rack7-node13, aps1a-rack7-node14, aps1a-rack7-node15 — alerts: gpu-firmware-fail, node-unreachable

jorge: are they all from the same vendor/firmware batch? pattern?

chris: yes — all flashed with firmware v2.3.7 yesterday around 02:00 UTC. dmesg shows repeated firmware checksum failures then oom.

chris: ```
[  12.345678] GPU: bios crc invalid (expected 0x1f2a, got 0xffff)
[  12.345700] NVRAM: failed checksum
[  12.346000] kernel panic - not syncing: Out of memory
```

maya: ok — who can run drains now? we should start evacuating pods/containers and spin up replacements in fallback region. i can take the drain ops if chris confirms node list.

chris: please do. run: `fleetctl drain --nodes aps1a-rack7-node12,aps1a-rack7-node13,aps1a-rack7-node14,aps1a-rack7-node15` then `kubectl get pods -o wide --field-selector=spec.nodeName=<node>` to verify migrations. also scale up warm pool in eu-west / aps2 as fallback.

sylvie: provisioning 4 replacement g4 nodes in aps2 now (warm pool). ETA ~12m, tagging them as replacements.

ops-oncall: applying capacity policy: shifting ~20% low-priority inference traffic to eu-west and aps2, degrading non-critical SLAs to preserve core capacity. notifying customers from the impacted tenant list.

jorge: is this correlated with the vendor blob in v2.3.7? if so, we should block that artifact and rollback pushes.

chris: agree. corrupted nodes can't be rolled back in-place. i'll block further v2.3.7 pushes in our firmware pipeline and stop the rollout job.

deploy-bot: Deployment pipeline halted for firmware:v2.3.7 — reason: manual stop by chris (@1932109876).

maya: commands i'm running now:
```
fleetctl drain aps1a-rack7-node12 --now
fleetctl drain aps1a-rack7-node13 --now
fleetctl drain aps1a-rack7-node14 --now
fleetctl drain aps1a-rack7-node15 --now
kubectl cordon aps1a-rack7-node12
```

chris: after drain completes, ops to reimage nodes with vendor recovery image. vendor support asked for serial & nvram dumps before any reflash. may need RMA if reflash fails.

sylvie: vendor support on call — i've uploaded serial logs and nvram dump to their ticket. they said reflash possible but ETA for RMA is 48-72h if hw is damaged. trying to get expedited recovery for 2 nodes.

ops-oncall: finance note — using eu-west warm pool and cross-region shift will increase cross-region egress and transient costs ~+3% this billing window. flagging to finance for visibility.

jorge: postmortem note: we need staged flashing (1% canary) and an automated firmware checksum validation step pre-commit. add incident tag fw-1932109876.

chris: creating incident ticket now and adding temporary policy to block firmware pushes to aps1a until we validate. also will schedule an RIT to test vendor recovery image on a spare node.

maya: drains succeeded, pods migrated, services reporting degraded but healthy. aps1a capacity now at ~95% after shift. replacement nodes in aps2 provisioning completes in ~8m.

infra-bot: capacity shift executed — eu-west scaled +4 nodes, aps2 scaled +4 nodes, alerts suppressed for affected nodes.

chris: thanks y'all. closing immediate thread — follow-up and postmortem in #incidents/1932109876. assigning action items: chris (incident lead), jorge (postmortem), maya (reimage ops), sylvie (vendor coord). :thumbsup:
